note: Pixel coords in each hammer-N-hand.webp (512x512). grip = point on the handle where the fist holds it; head = centre of the head. axisAngle = how far the drawn handle-to-head axis is already rotated clockwise from straight up (hammer-1 is drawn diagonally at ~43 deg; hammers 2-4 are straight, handle down, 0). To make any hammer point straight up (handle down) rotate it by -axisAngle about its grip. Grip sits ~22% of the way from the butt to the head centre on all four; grip-to-head distance: h1 344, h2 316, h3 318, h4 307 px (scale by it to equalise handle length).
